panels.title: Primitive risk factors per day by variation format

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, variation_format, count(DISTINCT fpr_id) AS fprs
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  AND ('__all' IN ($variation_format) OR variation_format IN ($variation_format))
  AND ('__all' IN ($capitalization) OR capitalization IN ($capitalization))
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, variation_format

panels.title: FPRs added / removed vs previous file

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt, fpr_id
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ('__all' IN ($variation_format) OR variation_format IN ($variation_format))
    AND ('__all' IN ($capitalization) OR capitalization IN ($capitalization))
),
dates AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, lag(trad_dt) OVER (ORDER BY trad_dt) AS prev_dt
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt FROM d)
),
added AS (
  SELECT c.trad_dt, count(*) AS n
  FROM (SELECT d.*, dates.prev_dt FROM d JOIN dates USING (trad_dt)) c
  ANTI JOIN d p ON p.trad_dt = c.prev_dt AND p.fpr_id = c.fpr_id
  GROUP BY 1
),
removed AS (
  SELECT r.trad_dt, count(*) AS n
  FROM (SELECT dates.trad_dt, p.fpr_id FROM dates JOIN d p ON p.trad_dt = dates.prev_dt) r
  ANTI JOIN d c ON c.trad_dt = r.trad_dt AND c.fpr_id = r.fpr_id
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT dates.trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  coalesce(a.n, 0)::BIGINT AS added,
  -coalesce(r.n, 0)::BIGINT AS removed
FROM dates
LEFT JOIN added a USING (trad_dt)
LEFT JOIN removed r USING (trad_dt)
WHERE dates.prev_dt IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(dates.trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: FPRs by format, capitalization and base (latest day in range)

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
    AND ('__all' IN ($variation_format) OR variation_format IN ($variation_format))
    AND ('__all' IN ($capitalization) OR capitalization IN ($capitalization))
)
SELECT concat_ws(' / ', variation_format, capitalization, day_count_base::VARCHAR || '/' || interpolation_base::VARCHAR) AS category,
  count(DISTINCT fpr_id) AS fprs
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY fprs DESC

WITH d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, fpr_id,
    any_value(fpr_name) AS fpr_name,
    any_value(variation_format) AS variation_format,
    any_value(capitalization) AS capitalization,
    any_value(day_count_base) AS day_count_base,
    any_value(interpolation_base) AS interpolation_base,
    string_agg(instrument_id::VARCHAR, ', ' ORDER BY instrument_id) AS instrument_ids
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ('__all' IN ($variation_format) OR variation_format IN ($variation_format))
    AND ('__all' IN ($capitalization) OR capitalization IN ($capitalization))
  GROUP BY trad_dt, fpr_id
),
dates AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, lag(trad_dt) OVER (ORDER BY trad_dt) AS prev_dt
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt FROM d)
),
changes AS (
  SELECT c.trad_dt, 'added' AS change, c.* EXCLUDE (trad_dt, prev_dt)
  FROM (SELECT d.*, dates.prev_dt FROM d JOIN dates USING (trad_dt)) c
  ANTI JOIN d p ON p.trad_dt = c.prev_dt AND p.fpr_id = c.fpr_id
  WHERE c.prev_dt IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL BY NAME
  SELECT r.cur_dt AS trad_dt, 'removed' AS change, r.* EXCLUDE (trad_dt, cur_dt)
  FROM (SELECT p.*, dates.trad_dt AS cur_dt FROM dates JOIN d p ON p.trad_dt = dates.prev_dt) r
  ANTI JOIN d c ON c.trad_dt = r.cur_dt AND c.fpr_id = r.fpr_id
)
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS trad_dt, change, fpr_id, fpr_name, variation_format, capitalization, day_count_base, interpolation_base, instrument_ids
FROM changes
WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY trad_dt DESC, change, fpr_name
LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Primitive risk factors (latest day in range)

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_primitive_risk_factors/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
    AND ('__all' IN ($variation_format) OR variation_format IN ($variation_format))
    AND ('__all' IN ($capitalization) OR capitalization IN ($capitalization))
)
SELECT fpr_id,
  any_value(fpr_name) AS fpr_name,
  any_value(variation_format) AS variation_format,
  any_value(capitalization) AS capitalization,
  any_value(day_count_base) AS day_count_base,
  any_value(interpolation_base) AS interpolation_base,
  any_value(fpr_group_id) AS fpr_group_id,
  count(*) AS instruments,
  string_agg(instrument_id::VARCHAR, ', ' ORDER BY instrument_id) AS instrument_ids
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
GROUP BY fpr_id
ORDER BY day_count_base NULLS LAST, fpr_name
LIMIT 5000
